issue.title: Get rid of `repositories.impl` settings totally

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Today we have multiple ways to define settings when a user needs to create a repository:

* in `elasticsearch.yml` file using `repositories.xxx` prefix where `xxx` is the implementation name like `s3`, `hdfs`...
* when creating the repository itself with `PUT _snaphot/repo`

Based on discussion we have on #22762 and on #22301 and also internally, I think we should reduce the overall complexity and completely remove support for global settings like this.

Actually, the creation of a repository is most of the time a unique manual operation so providing settings at repository creation time does not bring a lot of complexity for the end user.

And that will simplify **a lot** our code and our tests.

The plan would be:

* Deprecate `repositories.xxx` settings in 5.x:

- [x] Azure plugin (#22856)
- [x] S3 plugin (#23278)

* Remove `repositories.xxx` settings in 6.x (master branch):

- [x] Azure plugin (#23262)
- [ ] S3 plugin (#23276 has been closed. It will be done within another PR)

* Check other plugins:

- [X] GCS plugin (not needed as already not supported)
- [X] HDFS plugin (not needed as already not supported)

body:
@jbaiera actually I think that based on discussion we had with @rjernst about s3 plugin I think we should better get rid of `repositories.impl` settings totally (see #22800). It makes the code a way too much complex for a very little gain.

I'm going to open a PR about removing that from the documentation instead and we can discuss about it there (or here).

issue.title: repositories.hdfs.path can not be set

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Reported at: https://discuss.elastic.co/t/combine-elasticsearch-5-1-1-and-repository-hdfs/69659

If you define as described [in our docs](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/plugins/current/repository-hdfs-config.html) the following `elasticsearch.yml` settings:

```yml
repositories:
  hdfs:
    uri: "hdfs://es-master:9000/" # optional - Hadoop file-system URI
    path: "some/path" # required - path with the file-system where data is stored/loaded
```

It fails at startup because we don't register the global setting `repositories.hdfs.path` in `HdfsPlugin`.

This PR removes that from our docs so people must provide those settings only when registering the repository with:

```
PUT _snapshot/my_hdfs_repository
{
  "type": "hdfs",
  "settings": {
    "uri": "hdfs://namenode:8020/",
    "path": "elasticsearch/respositories/my_hdfs_repository",
    "conf.dfs.client.read.shortcircuit": "true"
  }
}
```

Based on issue #22800.

Closes #22301

body: @dadoonet I'm fine with this course of action. I think it makes sense if the general consensus is to move away from the pattern. Thanks much!
